registered_before: any final-run teacher label or model score (pilot = 20 engineering bases, excluded)
query: original target task from q_ref (target t0 -> goal), one target-Y query per state; never X / p11 / repairs
intervention: PROP_V1 (cf_generate.py): move ONE existing non-target obstacle to a free legal cell; N_OBJ=2, N_CF=4, N_NULL=4; objects and cells in sha256 order; NULL displacement-matched to the object's first CF proposal; no model output used

bases_3d.pool: historical 3D TEST (abf_9de85710c2a7103f): K0 roots with stored Y0=1 not in the pilot, plus one stored Y=1 repair endpoint (labels.D, sha256('CFBASE|root|edit') order) per other TEST root; every base re-verified by the teacher

bases_2d.pool: historical 2D TEST K0 roots with stored Y0=1; Ours-only diagnostic (no 2D baselines exist)

teacher.3d: CF_Y3D_V1 = fin3d.run_y steps + bd_3dt.label negative kind
teacher.2d: CF_Y2D_V1 = bxy_teacher.y_query on the edited record

acceptance.strong_triplet: BASE y=1 (re-verified) AND, for the first object (sha order) that has both, the first CF proposal (rank order) with y=0 and negative_kind CERTIFIED (3D) / CERTIFIED (2D CERTIFIED_INFEASIBLE) AND the first NULL proposal with y=1
acceptance.budget_cohort: same, with the CF y=0 only budget-limited (NO_PLAN_FOUND / UNKNOWN_*); reported separately, never called infeasible
acceptance.unknown: unresolved / execution-error states are excluded and counted, never coerced to 0

models.ours: bundle D scorer s0 (primary), s1, s2 -- p_Y = sigmoid(b) empty-edit (XYNet.predict p_noop)
models.grn: yadu/GRN runs/s0..s2 best.pt, native make_graph, sigmoid(action)
models.piginet: BLOCKED (no frozen weights on the laptop)
models.scnet: BLOCKED (no code / weights / prior evaluation locally)

metrics.cf_pair_auroc: pooled AUROC over all accepted BASE (pos) vs their CF (neg) scores, sklearn roc_auc_score (midrank ties)
metrics.null_retention: fraction of NULL with p>=0.5; also conditional on p_B>=0.5; mean |p_B-p_NULL|
metrics.oracle_null_false_flip: fraction of ALL attempted NULL proposals labelled y=0 (dataset metric, one value)
metrics.threshold: 0.5 (both models output BCE-trained sigmoid probabilities; no tuning)
metrics.ci: 2000 bootstrap replicates, seed 0, over base lineage (layout_root_id; one base per root)

stability: deterministic 25% subset (sha256('CFSTAB|qid')) of accepted CF and NULL re-labelled with planner seed 1

amendments.what: cf_teacher.py robustness fix after the first final 3D run crashed with 0 labels written: (1) a queried layout whose cell is still held mid-settle (edits on a repair-endpoint base) is built directly at the queried cells then settled (row flag build_mode=direct; parity of direct vs run_y path checked on conflict-free layouts); (2) per-query exceptions become explicit ERROR rows (excluded, counted). No acceptance rule, proposal, base, metric or model change; no label or score had been read.

amendments.registered_before: any 3D final-run model score and any 2D final-run label (3D teacher labels still being generated; triplet manifest not sealed)
amendments.change: models.piginet and models.scnet: BLOCKED -> AVAILABLE. Frozen teammate checkpoints located read-only on blackwell:~/yadu_bd/{piginet_shelf,scn_shelf} (no compute run there), copied to the laptop; no training, tuning or threshold fitting.
amendments.piginet: PIGINet-noimg runs/noimg_s{0,1,2}/best.pt (config no_image=true). Native 'move T' sample on the edited initial state, sigmoid(plan head), threshold 0.5. The image variant (full_s*) is EXCLUDED: CF/NULL states have no MuJoCo renders and rendering new CLIP features would be a new input pipeline.
amendments.scnet: SceneCollisionNet runs/adam_s{0,1,2}/best.pt; state score = max over 32 target grasps of P(grasp works) (train_scn.score_states); cloud scene_cloud(objects, edited cells, 8192 pts) seeded per base lineage sha256('CFSCN|root_id') (common random numbers within a triplet); grasp poses / shift rebuilt via cf_scnroots.py (parity 240/240 vs stored roots_scn.pkl).
amendments.adapter_validation: cf_infer.py on the baselines' own 370 V4 TEST 'move T' queries (labels.original): AUROC PIGINet .9875/.9866/.9879, SCNet .9718/.9693/.9651, GRN .9585/.9564/.9590, Ours .9831/.9823/.9773 -- matches P0 reproductions (PIGINet 0.987, SCNet 0.968 +- 0.003, GRN 0.958).

amendments.registered_before: any final 2D teacher label or 2D model score
amendments.change: 2D proposal family PROP_V1 -> PROP_V2_2D (cf_generate.proposals_v2_2d: CF cells ranked by the frozen grasp-screen kill tables MINK_TABLE_original; NULL = zero-kill cells, Chebyshev>=2, displacement-matched), N_OBJ 2 -> 4 objects per base (sha order), N_CF = N_NULL = 4.
amendments.reason: 2D engineering pilot (20 bases, excluded from the final): PROP_V1 certified CF flip 2.3% (3/132), NULL false-flip 9.1% (12/132), STRONG 2/20; PROP_V2 (N_OBJ 2) certified CF flip 3.8% (5/132), NULL false-flip 2.5% (3/122), STRONG 2/20, BUDGET 7/20. The 2D teacher rarely certifies infeasibility (screen full-kill CFs: 4/18 CERTIFIED, 11/18 UNKNOWN_PLANNER), so STRONG yield stays low; V2 is kept for its cleaner NULLs and more objects per base raise the chance of a matched triplet. 3D family unchanged (PROP_V1).
